description.narrative: The project will improve the effective delivery of local infrastructure and services by local authorities in less-developed areas of Sri Lanka. Under the project, about 100 local authorities selected in seven provinces (excluding the Northern and Eastern provinces), whose reform plans are reviewed and confirmed by the government, will implement subprojects for roads and bridges, water supply and sanitation, drainage, solid waste management, and other basic facilities, including building or enhancing health-care centers and public markets. The project will support the institutional strengthening of the local authorities for improved and sustainable service delivery through business process reengineering and the development of their information technology (IT) systems.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved local infrastructure and services delivered effectively by local authorities or the National Water Supply and Drainage Board in less-developed areas of seven provinces in Sri Lanka.

Population served by piped water systems increased by 20% on average in local authorities implementing water supply subprojects (baseline: 27% in 2011 in sample local authorities). Achievement: 47 Progress/Status: Population served by piped water supply has increased by 20% in all water supply schemes taken under the project. Outcome achieved in L 2790 SRI Subprojects in L 3431 in progress. House connections being given. Currently 28,500 connections are provided. Data Source: Project-specific evaluation survey at the completion of each road subproject

Travel time to markets reduced by 20% on average in local authorities implementing road subprojects (baseline: 27 minutes in 2011 in the sample local authorities). Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Travel time reduced by a minimum of 20% for all the road projects taken in the original project.
No road projects in additional financing. Data Source: Project-specific evaluation survey at the completion of each road subproject

Drinking water that meets quality standards benefitted 200,000 people (100,000 women) in CKD-affected areas. Achievement: y Progress/Status: L 3431: Designed to cover 211,083 Beneficiaries, Details of no. of woman being collected.
Details of women newly served is already collected and around 16,482 (connections-Female beneficiary details ) women newly served. Data Source: Project quarterly progress reports and one completion report issued by MPCLG Base year: 2011 Baseline value: N

Final accounts of participating local authorities audited within 6 months from the end of fiscal year (2011 baseline: delay in preparation of final accounts and audits). Achievement: y Progress/Status: L 2790 As per details collected the average time of submission of all PSs is reduced to 29 March. Auditing dates have also improved with respect to earlier situation. L 3431 Base year will be taken as 2017. Continued collection of details. Auditor General's report for the FYE 2022 received on 28 June 2023 by ADB, and disclosed in ADB Website. Data Source: Annual audit reports issued by the Auditor General's Department Base year: 2011 Baseline value: N

New systems and processes for taxation, licensing and approval are introduced as a result of business process reengineering (2011 baseline: old and time-taking systems). Achievement: y Progress/Status: The guidelines are formulated and issued to the PSs for implementation along with the required training. Outcome achieved in L2790. The efforts are continued in L3431 and several training programs conducted, and further training programs in progress. However scheduled training programs for March - May was delayed due to COVID situation.
ePuraNeguma - IT systems - (i) Forms and Receipts; (ii) Application Tracking Systems; (iii) Rates/Assessment Tax Management. Installed and training provided for PS staff on BPR recommendation of CDTA. (Both for LA's of Original Project and AF.).Asset Management Software Developed for Pilot LAs. Data Source: Project quarterly progress and completion reports issued by MPCLG Base year: 2011 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Water supply systems in CKD-affected areas improved Indicator: 1a) (i) at least 30 schemes developed or expanded in CKD-affected areas benefiting women and men. (Baseline: 0.) Achievement: 15 Progress/Status: The Additional Finance components in progress. 18 schemes completed and others are in progress. (77% of projects completed to date)
As of now 16,210 House Service Connections are provided. Data Source: Project quarterly progress and completion reports issued by MPCLG

Output: 1. Water supply systems in CKD-affected areas improved Indicator: 1b) 800 km of water distribution network laid. (Baseline: 0.) Achievement: 253 Progress/Status: 1372 km of pipe laying has completed and 329 Km handed over to NWSDB. Data Source: Project quarterly progress and completion reports issued by MPCLG
Output: 2. Local infrastructure and basic services delivery improved Indicator: 2.a (ii) Out of 6,000 households, 14,000 women are newly served Data Source: Quarterly progress reports. Actual value:

Output: 2. Local infrastructure and basic services delivery improved Indicator: 2.b) Improvement to solid waste management systems, including composting in 50 local authorities Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: L 2790: Solid Waste Management action plan drawn for all 108 PSs. Home composting bins were supplied to 82 local authorities. L 3431: The Commissioners of Local Government of all provinces also support implementation of Solid Waste Management Action Plans. Most of the project Pradeshiya Sabhas have been supported by the project in terms of providing home compost bins which are the part of Solid Waste Management Action Plans Reform Plans of Additional Financing also include Solid Waste Management action measures. Data Source: Project quarterly progress and completion reports issued by MPCLG

Output: 2. Local infrastructure and basic services delivery improved Indicator: 2.c) Constructed or improved 25 km of local roads. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: All Road works completed in L 2790 28 Km of local roads are taken up for improvement under the project in different pradeshiya sabhas. Only 300m access road in L3431 no other road works under additional financing. Data Source: Project quarterly progress and completion reports issued by MPCLG

Output: 2. Local infrastructure and basic services delivery improved Indicator: 2.d) Constructed or improved 30 public primary health care facilities Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: All works completed in L 2790 31 primary health centers constructed under L2790. Works in 9 health care centers being implemented under L3431. Data Source: Project quarterly progress and completion reports issued by MPCLG

Output: 2. Local infrastructure and basic services delivery improved Indicator: 2.e) Constructed or improved 45 public markets. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: All works completed in L 2790. 46 public markets constructed in L 2790. L3431: one weekly fair is completed under the AF and 7 in progress. Data Source: Project quarterly progress and completion reports issued by MPCLG

Output: 3. Local government policy reform advanced and capacity strengthened Indicator: 3.b) Bottlenecks in current tax, licensing, and approval systems of local governments are analyzed and training provided to 140 local authorities (2011 baseline: old system; no local authorities trained).
